item.title: Southwest Ladies End Season, Headed to Districts
item.description: The Southwest Lady Wildcats ended the season against Tri-County of Jamesport coming up short 52 – 31. The Wildcats were led by Charlee Warner with 10; 6 teammates were also on the board. Alexis Neeley led Tri-County with 17 points. The Lady Wildcats go into district play on Monday.
